title: Chapter 238 Nanshan Group’S Ambition
content:
Chapter 238 Nanshan Group’S Ambition

Wang Shuo directly asked the waiter to arrange a private room upstairs.

Soon, the wine and food were served, and Chef Zhang also walked in after learning the news.

"Brother Wang, long time no see. How are you?"

"Brother Chef, I haven't seen you for a few days. Your business is getting more and more popular!"

"It's not as good as you big lords. Now you are famous in Nanshanji!"

The two exchanged polite words, and Wang Shuo picked up a piece of animal meat and took a bite.

The meat is tender and delicious!

"Brother Chef, can you introduce to me the current situation of Nanshan Market?"

Wang Shuo raised his glass and looked at Chef Zhang.

Chef Zhang put down the wine glass in his hand and said slowly: "Brother Wang is unaware of something. The current situation in Nanshan Market can be said to be quite complicated."

"Mayor Lin came out of nowhere and took over all the system forces. He also recruited players into the army and built fortifications. The development of Nanshanji is really changing with each passing day."

"It's just that the gang forces in Nanshanji are very dissatisfied. On the surface, they have surrendered to Mayor Lin, but secretly they have their own agendas. However, they had many conflicts in the first place, and now they just seem to be in harmony with each other."

Wang Shuo raised his eyebrows and became interested.

"Speak to me carefully!"

The restaurant where Chef Zhang works has been visited by people of all kinds for a long time, and it is a good place to collect intelligence.

Chef Zhang looked around and looked at Wang Shuo's men.

Wang Shuo smiled and said, "It doesn't matter."

Chef Zhang then whispered: "Some time ago, several gangs had a fierce battle outside the town, but no one could do anything to anyone, so they reached a secret agreement."

"As for what the agreement was, I don't know. Just like that, Nanshanji barely calmed down for a while, and then Lin Guanru, who claimed to be the mayor, appeared and summoned gang forces to enter the lord's mansion. I don't know what was discussed."

"Nanshanji is under the jurisdiction of various forces and has developed rapidly. However, the taxes charged on our shops are a bit high."

"I heard that Nanshanji has opened a teleportation array. Does the chef know about this?"

"Of course I know, but the cost of each teleportation is not low. It requires 10 gold coins. There are many people teleporting from other towns. I still have a few living here!"

Wang Shuo nodded noncommittally.

After coming out of Fuyue Restaurant, Wang Shuo happened to meet Fan Chengyang on the street.

This is really a narrow road for enemies!

"Hey, isn't this Lord Lord Wang? I didn't expect you to dare to come to Nanshan Fair!" Fan Chengyang said with a smile when he saw Wang Shuo coming over.

Wang Shuo no longer looks down on this kind of thing. The other person is completely different from him.

I didn't intend to pay attention to him, but the other party refused to let him go.

"Wang Shuo, I really didn't expect you to dare to come here. Once you reach our Iron Sword Sect's territory, I'm afraid you won't be able to go back!"

Gong Zheng immediately took a step forward and looked at Fan Chengyang with wide eyes, a fierce look on his face.

"What are you doing? Do you still want to act wild in Nanshanji?" Fan Chengyang had a look of fear on his face.

After all, there were more than ten people in Wang Shuo's group, but he only had five, and their levels and equipment were far behind.

Wang Shuo just snorted contemptuously.

Walking by Fan Chengyang, Wang Shuo glanced at him sideways, curled up the corners of his mouth slightly, and revealed a wicked smile.

Fan Chengyang looked at Wang Shuo walking away, his heart suddenly broke out for no reason, and he was dripping with cold sweat.

Wang Shuo walked on the street. An important purpose of this trip was to find a business partner with whom he could cooperate.

Wang Shuo no longer plans to go to shopkeeper Li. This person is too timid, which makes Wang Shuo a little worried.

After walking, we came to the system store.

Wang Shuo felt happy and thought of a good idea.
